_what_this_is: Every case in set4.json, and a four-by-four of the messages a room actually produces, read through the shipped judgement: watchAs() from src/watch.ts over llamaWatchModel() from src/llama.ts against /v1/systemone. One message per fresh world, so no case rides on another's delta. Each row keeps the exact state the endpoint was sent, so the figure watch-v4 advertises can be recomputed from this file alone.
_why_this_file_exists: the cut watch-v4 ships is applied to a probability, and a probability is only meaningful together with the text that produced it. The previous records (calibration/measured.json, calibration/vision/server-transport.json) measured a different reading on a different model: one token sampled after a sentence ending "Answer act or ignore", summed over the spellings of the option. Nothing here sums anything — the endpoint answers with one probability per declared answer.
transport: /v1/systemone, one named question of type `choice`, two declared answers
